title: API authorization / verb tampering
summary: Test method/role/function-level authorization on mapped APIs.
steps: From api_samples, try verb swaps (GET↔PUT/DELETE) on sensitive resources.
compare_requests across anon/A/B roles for the same endpoint.

Missing [Authorize] writes: compare_requests unauth POST a 401 sibling vs SaveSettings/Save*/Write* with one canary json body and use_auth_session=false. 200 Content-Length: 0 is ASP.NET void success.
Mass-assignment: add role/is_admin/owner fields when serializers are exposed.
On PASS: unauthorized verb/role succeeds with state or data proof.
